import { type ConfigPlugin, IOSConfig } from 'expo/config-plugins';

// Inline, not a sibling module or file read: Expo's plugin loader cannot resolve a sibling .ts, and a Node built-in breaks the build fingerprint.
export const QA_NATIVE_RED_BOX_VIEW_SOURCE = `#if DEBUG

#import <React/RCTRedBox.h>
#import <React/RCTView.h>
#import <React/RCTViewManager.h>

@interface QANativeRedBoxView : RCTView
@property (nonatomic, strong) RCTRedBox *redBox;
@property (nonatomic, assign) BOOL raised;
@end

@implementation QANativeRedBoxView

- (void)layoutSubviews
{
  [super layoutSubviews];
  if (self.raised || self.window == nil || CGRectIsEmpty(self.bounds)) return;
  self.raised = YES;
  [self.redBox showErrorMessage:@"QA native view manager: first layout error" withStack:@[]];
}

- (void)didMoveToWindow
{
  [super didMoveToWindow];
  if (self.window != nil) [self setNeedsLayout];
}

@end

@interface QANativeRedBoxViewManager : RCTViewManager
@end

@implementation QANativeRedBoxViewManager

@synthesize moduleRegistry = _moduleRegistry;

RCT_EXPORT_MODULE(QANativeRedBoxView)

- (UIView *)view
{
  QANativeRedBoxView *view = [QANativeRedBoxView new];
  view.redBox = [self.moduleRegistry moduleForName:"RedBox"];
  return view;
}

@end

#endif
`;

const withIosNativeRedBox: ConfigPlugin = (config) =>
  IOSConfig.XcodeProjectFile.withBuildSourceFile(config, {
    filePath: 'QANativeRedBoxView.m',
    contents: QA_NATIVE_RED_BOX_VIEW_SOURCE,
    overwrite: true,
  });

export default withIosNativeRedBox;
